args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

Gideon Sato, here's a draft for Mateo's procurement team, built from #inc-vtg-hartford (times Central, 3 Aug 2026):

Subject: Hartford gate check-in incident summary

On Monday 3 Aug 2026 the gate kiosks at Vantorre's Hartford plant went offline, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. Appointment scheduling was unaffected and still worked from the dispatch office. The guard logged trailers manually while the kiosks were down.

- First report: 10:42 AM
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch)
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM)

Carrowmere Cloud investigated the Hartford gateway route. We are keeping the incident open for one more arrival cycle. The separate status-page access issue is still open under ticket INC-4821.

Note: the channel gives no root cause, so I left one out. I haven't sent this to anyone. Mateo's team is external to pemberline.com, so mailing it would need Ruth Calloway's approval.

Gideon Sato, two corrections to my draft. The channel doesn't state a timezone, so please ignore "Central" and confirm it before this goes out. The channel also only shows INC-4821 as open on 3 Aug, so check whether it's still open now.

The channel gives no root cause, so the draft doesn't state one. I haven't emailed it to anyone. Mateo's team is outside pemberline.com, so sending it by mail would need Ruth Calloway's approval.

FINAL: Hartford gate check-in incident summary

On Monday 3 Aug 2026 the gate kiosks at Vantorre's Hartford plant went offline, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. Appointment scheduling was unaffected and still worked from the dispatch office. The guard logged trailers manually while the kiosks were down.

- First report: 10:42 AM
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch)
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM

Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route. Separately, the status-page access issue is tracked in INC-4821. The incident was kept open for another arrival cycle after both lanes recovered.
